mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4% over the prior 3 months reduces the discount rate applied to future earnings, lowering the present value of expected equity returns and thus producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises for 3 consecutive months above 4%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (p < 0.05) during the identified FEDFUNDS rise period.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS (monthly payrolls) coincides with stronger consumer confidence and higher wage growth, which together signal a resilient labor market that supports equity risk premium expansion and positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate > 2% for two consecutive months and HOUST > 550
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over the 60-day horizon in all periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) followed by a rebound above the prior low indicates a turning point in supply-side constraints, prompting market participants to price in a faster normalization of S&P 500 valuations and generating positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO drops 3% then crosses above previous low within 2 months
failure_condition: No statistically significant positive return (p > 0.05) in the 20-day window following the identified rebound.

mechanism_narrative: When the ratio of new orders (GDPC1) to capacity utilization (not available in the catalog) would imply underutilization persists for more than 6 months, the market anticipates slower growth and reverts to discounting future earnings, producing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in all 6-month windows of supply slack.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2% for two consecutive months triggers the Federal Reserve to signal tighter policy, which compresses the equity risk premium and drives negative 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (p < 0.05) during the inflation spike.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for 4 consecutive months, accompanied by rising wage growth (implied by HOUST), indicates a tight labor market that supports equity premium expansion and positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% for 4 consecutive months and HOUST increases 10% over the same period
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns show no significant deviation from zero (p > 0.05) in all tightening regimes.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly retail sales (not available) would show double-digit year-over-year growth for three consecutive months, market participants anticipate a demand surge that justifies premium pricing and positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in all 12-month windows of double-digit YoY growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in manufacturing activity (RSAFS) below 50% of trend for 8 consecutive months suggests structural supply-side weakness that persists in investor expectations, producing negative 20-day forward returns regardless of macro regime.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative in all 8-month contraction periods.
